IC1: Severe Hypertension [AND] Grade 3 WHO classification (Mean Sitting Diastolic Blood Pressure (MSDBP) [OR] 110 mmHg and/or Mean Sitting Systolic Blood Pressure MSSBP 180 mmHg)
IC2: Acetylsalicyclic acid (ASA) treatment [OR] >1g/day or regular use of Non steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAIDs)
IC3: Kidney disease [OR] not caused by diabetes [OR] or hypertension
IC5: GFR < 40 ml/min/1.73m2 as measured by the MDRD formula
IC7: History of hypertensive encephalopathy [OR] or cerebrovascular accident at any time prior to Visit1.
IC8: Current diagnosis of heart failure (New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class II-IV)
IC9: History of myocardial infarction [OR], unstable angina pectoris [OR], coronary bypass surgery [OR], or any percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) during the 6 months prior to Visit 1
IC10: Second [OR] or third degree heart block [AND] [NOT] without a pacemaker
IC11: Concurrent potentially life threatening arrhythmia [OR] or symptomatic arrhythmia
IC14: Uncontrolled Type II diabetes mellitus (Hemaglobin subtype A1C (HbA1C) >11 %)
IC15: History of malignancy including leukemia [OR] and lymphoma (but not basal cell skin carcinoma) within the past five years
IC16: Participation in any clinical investigation within 4 weeks prior to dosing or longer if required by local regulation.
IC17: Donation [OR] or loss of 400 mL or more of blood within 8 weeks prior to dosing.
IC18: Significant illness within the two weeks prior to dosing.
IC19: Any surgical [OR] or medical condition which might significantly alter the absorption, distribution, metabolism, or excretion of study drugs including, but not limited to, any of the following:
IC20: History [AND] of major gastrointestinal tract surgery such as gastrectomy [OR], gastroenterostomy [OR], or bowel resection
IC21: -Currently active [OR] or previously active inflammatory bowel disease during the 12 months prior to Visit 1 Currently active gastritis, duodenal or gastric ulcers, or gastrointestinal [OR]/rectal bleeding during the 3 months prior to Visit 1.
IC22: Any history [OR] of pancreatic injury [OR], pancreatitis [OR] or evidence of impaired pancreatic [OR] function/injury as indicated by abnormal lipase [OR] or amylase Evidence of hepatic disease [OR], a history [OR] of hepatic encephalopathy, a history [OR] of esophageal varices, or a history [AND] of portocaval shunt
IC23: Current treatment with cholestyramine [OR] or cholestipol resins
IC24: History [AND] of immunocompromise [OR], including a positive HIV test result.
IC25: History of a positive Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) [OR] or Hepatitis C test result.
IC26: History of drug [OR] or alcohol abuse within the 12 months prior to dosing.
IC27: Persons directly involved in the execution of this protocol.
IC28: Any condition that [OR] in the opinion of [OR] the investigator or the Novartis medical monitor would jeopardize the evaluation of efficacy or safety
IC29: History of noncompliance to medical regimens [OR] or unwillingness to comply with the study protocol
IC30: Known or suspected contraindications [AND] to the study medications, including history of allergy [AND] to Angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors [OR] and/or to thiazide diuretics [OR] or other sulfonamide derived drug
IC31: Any surgical [OR] or medical condition [AND], which in the opinion of the investigator, may place the patient at higher risk from his/her participation in the study, or is likely to prevent the patient from complying with the requirements of the study or completing the study
IC32: Use of any prescription drug [OR] or over-the-counter (OTC) medication which is prohibited by the protocol.
IC33: Patients who previously participated in any Aliskiren study.
IC35: Other protocol-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria may apply
